📖 Verdis VM Instruction Reference
PUSH val — Push a value onto the stack
POP — Remove top of stack
ADD — Pop two, push their sum
SUB — Pop two, push difference
MUL — Pop two, push product
DIV — Pop two, push quotient
MOD — Pop two, push modulo
EQ — Pop two, push 1 if equal
LT — Pop two, push 1 if first < second
GT — Pop two, push 1 if first > second
STORE — Save to contract storage (pop key, pop value)
LOAD — Read from contract storage (pop key, push value)
JUMP label — Jump to a label/offset
JUMPI label — Conditional jump (if top of stack is truthy)
CALL — Call an external function
LOG val — Log a value (visible in execution output)
EMIT event — Emit an event
DUP — Duplicate top of stack
SWAP — Swap top two stack items
SSTORE — Store in transient storage
SLOAD — Load from transient storage
HALT — Stop execution
LABEL name — Define a jump target (or name:)
💡 Tips: Use PUSH 'key' for string values. Use 'label_name:' or LABEL name to define jump targets. Comments start with // or #.
